channel.title: Muhammad Basit Ali
channel.description: Open-source tooling for AI agent security and cloud security: Claude Code skill packs, MCP servers and linters, threat modelling, Semgrep rules and an AI agent incident dataset.

item.title: What do skills that ask for the whole shell do with it?
item.description: I read 3,715 public agent skills that grant unscoped Bash. Three in ten never show a shell command, most of the rest need three commands or fewer, and a third install, delete, push or eval.

item.title: Do MCP server READMEs tell you which version to run?
item.description: I read the install commands in the READMEs of 264 public MCP servers. 95.5% never name an exact version, and a quarter ask for the latest release on every launch.
